mode_default_detail: Asks before editing files or running commands
mode_accept_edits_detail: Edits files without asking, still asks before commands
mode_plan_detail: Reads code and writes a plan; acts only once you approve
mode_auto_detail: Judges the risk itself and goes ahead with safe steps
mode_bypass_permissions_detail: Never asks; can only be chosen when starting
mode_bypass_permissions_assistant_detail: Edits files and runs commands without asking. Risky
bypass_warning: Full access: edits files and runs commands without asking
codex_effort_ultra_detail: Most careful, and splits work across several subagents · uses a lot of quota
